name: hopping-watcher
description: Reports your current project + finished agents to the local Hopping hub.

commands.title: Hopping: Mark current project as waiting on you

hopping.hubPort.description: Port of the local Hopping hub.

hopping.agentCommandPattern.description: Regex (case-insensitive): a finished terminal command matching this flips the project to 'waiting on you'.

scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run build && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o hopping-watcher.vsix
